Latin word

subolet

subolet (mihi)

impersonal, third person only: the person who suspects in the dative, the thing suspected as subject

I smell a rat, I suspect something

In this lexicon

  • smell a rat

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Ps. 1.5.7: id jam prīdem sēnsī et subolet mihi (Lewis & Short s.v. suboleō); Ter. Ph. 3.1.10: Num quid patrī subolet? — Nihil etiam. (Lewis & Short s.v. etiam); Traupman 106: I smell a rat, aliquid mihi subolet; Traupman 406

Examples

  • Num quid patrī subolet? — Nihil etiam.

    Does Father suspect anything? — Nothing at all.Ter. Ph. 3.1.10 (Lewis & Short s.v. etiam)

    In the entry for smell a rat

  • subolēre

    to get a whiff ofTraupman 406

    In the entry for smell a rat

  • Jam prīdem id mihi subolēbat.

    I got wind of it long ago.Traupman 407
